english.note: Use 口碑 when referring specifically to the public’s assessment of someone or something, usually a positive reputation.

examples.english: This restaurant has a good reputation, so it’s best to book on weekends.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳口碑好，周末最好訂位。
